neighbours.label: ' but' in an 'ADJ but not ADJ' degree qualifier (tender but not mushy)
fire: Simmer the beans until they are tender but not falling apart.
The sauce should be thick but not gluey when you take it off the heat.
Toast the almonds until fragrant but not burnt.
Blend the soup until smooth but not foamy.
Whip the cream until firm but not grainy.
Steam the broccoli until bright green but not soggy.
Knead the dough until elastic but not sticky.
Pulse the herbs until finely chopped but not pasty.
quiet: Simmer the beans until they are tender and creamy.
The sauce should be thick and glossy when you take it off the heat.
Toast the almonds until fragrant and golden.
Blend the soup until smooth and silky.
Whip the cream until firm and fluffy.
Steam the broccoli until bright green and crisp.
Knead the dough until elastic and soft.
Pulse the herbs until finely chopped and fragrant.

notes: card: ' but' x13 (tender but not mushy), ' still' x5; probe: 'soft but not brown' 0.63, 'light but warm' 0.02, 'soft and golden' 0.06.
